summary: Traced recovery after a refused snapshot install: the snapshot-status handler clears the pending snapshot index and moves the replica to the wait state with next recomputed from its match, and the next heartbeat response both calls waitToRetry and sends a replicate message for the missing range (tryUpdate does the same on any accepted response that advances match), so the replica cannot be stranded in the non-sendable state. Recorded one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account, noting that repair waits at least one heartbeat and assumes heartbeats continue. No execution requested.
